title: Immediate Agent Cancellation on User Stop and Drag to Backlog
summary: Enforced immediate agent cancellation and responsive abort handling: 1) In internal_move_task_stage, if moved to backlog, a non-autorun stage, or if moving a running task, any active agent handle in state.active_agents is flagged for abort and its JoinHandle is explicitly aborted with handle.abort(); task status is set to idle when moved to backlog, and backlog never emits agent:autorun. 2) In abort_agent, injected app_handle, aborted the join handle, updated tasks.json to idle, and emitted tasks:updated and agent:status idle to immediately update UI. 3) In run_agent, abort exits cleanly reset task status to idle without triggering error banners. 4) In agent.rs, ReAct loop, execute_tool, and subagents check abort_flag before and after every tool call.
commitMessage: feat(agent): immediate cancellation on stop and backlog move (#fix-agent-stop-and-backlog-abort)
author: Lead Systems Engineer (tauri-rust-engineer)
